title: Post-construction stormwater management facilities.
officialText:
A post-construction stormwater management facility that is constructed as part of a covered development project shall comply with the rules of the Department of Environmental Protection and with this code.
*Section 106.6.3 was amended by Local Law 97 of 2017. This law has an effective date of June 1, 2019.
**Section 106.6.3 was amended by Local Law 91 of 2020. This law has an effective date of March 26, 2021.
